events.title: 30-30-30 Fibre Challenge
events.description: 30 days. 30 g of fibre a day. 30 plants a week. Do the day's action from your guide and tick it off.

events.title: Fibre Challenge Day 1: measure and make the breakfast bowl
events.description: Measure your waist (men) or hips (women), fill in the baseline page of your guide and make Nora's breakfast bowl.

events.title: Fibre Challenge Day 31: measure again
events.description: Measure the same way you did on day one, score yourself again and share what changed in the challenge community.
